description: ASR ReplicationProtectedItem provider-specific details are polymorphic on instanceType (A2A, Azure, HyperVReplicaAzure, InMageRcm, ...); the converted model keeps only the `instanceType` discriminator, so S.Struct strips every subtype field on encode and decode. Retype them as untyped documents.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The ReplicationProviderInput. For HyperVReplicaAzure provider, it will be AzureEnableProtectionInput object. For San provider, it will be SanEnableProtectionInput object. For HyperVReplicaAzure provider, it can be null. Polymorphic on `instanceType` (e.g. `{ instanceType: "A2A", ... }`).
